projectDescription: CVR-MATE is an automated B2B lead intelligence platform for Danish companies, combining CVR registry search, AI-assisted workflows, CRM integrations, and team collaboration in a single SaaS product.
keyFeatures: CVR registry search with advanced filters (industry, location, company type, size, founding date)
Scheduled lead triggers with cron-based monitoring and in-app notifications
AI-powered company briefings, outreach drafting, and pipeline analysis via Google Gemini
CRM integrations with HubSpot, Pipedrive, and LeadConnector
Person/participant tracking with real-time role-change alerts
Team workspaces with role-based access control (owner, admin, member) — Enterprise plan
Stripe billing with Free, Starter, Professional, and Enterprise tiers (priced in DKK)
Real-time in-app notifications via Server-Sent Events (SSE)
Data exports (PDF, XLSX) and company notes
publicApiSurface: GET /api/cvr/search — Search Danish companies with filter params
GET /api/cvr/company — Fetch company detail by VAT
GET /api/cvr/suggest — Autocomplete suggestions for company name search
GET/POST /api/triggers — List and create lead triggers
PATCH/DELETE /api/triggers/[id] — Update or delete a trigger
PATCH/DELETE /api/todos/[id] — Update or delete a todo
GET /api/notifications/stream — SSE stream for real-time notifications
POST /api/ai/draft-outreach — Generate AI outreach email/LinkedIn/phone script
POST /api/ai/enrich-company — AI enrichment for a company profile
POST /api/ai/enrich-person — AI enrichment for a participant/person
POST /api/ai/parse-search — Parse natural-language query to CVR filter params
POST /api/ai/suggest-todos — AI-suggested todos for a company
POST /api/stripe/portal — Create Stripe billing portal session
